'''Dreho Dreho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunter]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He had a base on [[Carrick Station]], where he bought and sold artifacts and relics from other travelers.

==Behind the scenes==
Dreho Dreho appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] created by [[BioWare]] and released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He is a Treasure Hunting crew skill trainer on Carrick Station for the Republic.
